theorem_statement: Theorem (filtered balanced CE rank-drop ideals and fibre dimensions at (g,n)=(6,6)). Let k be a characteristic-zero field and B a locally Noetherian k-scheme. Let pi:C->B be smooth proper with geometrically connected genus-six fibres, and let Gamma be the union of six pairwise-disjoint sections of pi. Assume balanced tetragonal Casnati-Ekedahl data supply the canonical filtration 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 on C with W_4,W_5 invertible of constant fibre degrees 20 and 16 (no global splitting of W required). Write phi:pi_*W->pi_*(W|_Gamma) and phi_f:pi_*W_f->pi_*(W_f|_Gamma) for the evaluation maps, L:=W_5 tensor omega_{C/B}^{-1}, N:=omega_{C/B} tensor W_5^vee(Gamma), a_N:B->Pic^0_{C/B} the classifying map of N, and e the identity section of Pic^0. Then: (i) pi_*W_4, pi_*W_5, pi_*W, pi_*(W_4|_Gamma), pi_*(W_5|_Gamma), and pi_*(W|_Gamma) are locally free of ranks 15, 11, 26, 6, 6, and 12 respectively, and formation of these sheaves and of phi, phi_f commutes with arbitrary locally Noetherian base change. (ii) Without any global splitting of W one has a canonical isomorphism coker(phi) isomorphic to coker(phi_5), hence Fit_0(coker phi)=I_12(phi)=I_6(phi_5) as ideal sheaves on B. (iii) Moreover I_11(phi)=O_B: every geometric fibre of phi has rank 12 or 11 and never smaller. Combined with the dual-confirmed Fitting/Picard identity of ATT-0065, the common maximal-minor ideal equals a_N^*I_e scheme-theoretically, represents relative triviality of N, and descends along smooth atlases. (iv) Under the additional ambient CE resolution and equation-bundle finite-local-freeness/base-change hypotheses of ATT-0065, the ambient CE evaluation map has the same cokernel and the same failure scheme. (v) On every geometric fibre C_b the geometric rank-drop set among effective degree-six divisors is the complete linear system |L_b|, of dimension h^0(L_b)-1. Writing M_b:=omega_{C_b}^{tensor 2} tensor W_{5,b}^vee one has deg M_b=4 and h^0(L_b)=1+h^0(M_b), so 1<=h^0(L_b)<=4 and dim|L_b| lies in {0,1,2,3}. Equality h^0(L_b)=4 holds if and only if C_b is hyperelliptic and M_b isomorphic to 2 g^1_2. (vi) The ordered reduced-support fibre is an open finite etale S_6-cover (at stack level) of the reduced-support open in |L_b|; it is either empty or of dimension h^0(L_b)-1. Nonemptiness of that open is not implied by chi(L_b)=1.
